title: The Acts of the Disputation with the Heresiarch Manes
label: Mani's teaching, refuted by Archelaus
basis: Mani's letter to Marcellus (chapter 5). The work's own reply: Archelaus refutes Mani in the disputation before the judges.

title: The Acts of the Disputation with the Heresiarch Manes
label: Mani's teaching, refuted by Archelaus
basis: Turbo's account of Mani's doctrine (chapters 7 to 11). The work's own reply: Archelaus refutes Mani in the disputation before the judges.

title: The Acts of the Disputation with the Heresiarch Manes

title: The Acts of the Disputation with the Heresiarch Manes

title: The Acts of the Disputation with the Heresiarch Manes

title: The Octavius of Minucius Felix
label: Caecilius, pagan objection; answered by Octavius
basis: Caecilius's case against Christianity (chapters 5 to 13). The work's own reply: Octavius answers it from chapter 16, and Caecilius concedes in chapter 40.

title: Council of Ephesus
label: Letter of Nestorius, condemned by the Council of Ephesus
basis: Read at the council's first session (22 June 431), which judged it contrary to the faith of Nicaea and deposed Nestorius.

title: Council of Constance
label: Condemned articles of John Wyclif (Council of Constance)
basis: Council of Constance, session 8 (4 May 1415), condemned the 45 articles of John Wyclif.

title: Council of Constance
label: Condemned articles of Jan Hus (Council of Constance)
basis: Council of Constance, session 15 (6 July 1415), condemned the 30 articles of Jan Hus.
